lessons.title: The Forensic Lifecycle 🔄
lessons.description: Explore the 5-phase journey every digital investigation follows from start to finish.

lessons.title: Identification & Assessment 🕵️‍♂️
lessons.description: Learn to scope an investigation and locate every possible piece of digital evidence.

lessons.title: Collection & Preservation 📦
lessons.description: Master the art of seizing digital evidence safely without altering a single byte.

lessons.title: Examination & Extraction 🔬
lessons.description: Filter mountains of data, extract key artifacts, and prepare evidence for deep analysis.

lessons.title: Analysis & Reconstruction 🧩
lessons.description: Turn raw data into a coherent story – timeline events, correlate findings, and draw conclusions.

lessons.title: Reporting & Presentation 📝
lessons.description: Craft a bulletproof forensic report and learn how to present your findings in court.
